svg.text: ◆ Chains use 8-direction adjacency and must match both color and Platonic shape.
◆ Parity counts ordinary gems only. Even begins empty; odd begins with a matching shell.
◆ Compatible solids may connect through an unoccupied shell using Rupert permeability.
◆ Satellites advance residue: EMPTY → SHELL → SOLID → EMPTY.
◆ Multiple participating satellites can create a prismatic satellite.
◆ Shells carrying satellites cannot be used for Rupert traversal.
◆ Chains of 8+ ordinary gems create a prismatic gem at the clicked position.
◆ One rescue shuffle is available if no move remains but a compatible pair exists.
◆ If no legal move remains after the rescue opportunity, the current level restarts.
◆ Clearing every satellite advances the level while preserving the shared score.
